TRACE IT

Overview

MAIN

A cozy paper-style train-track logic puzzle. Use the row and column numbers to lay one railway from entrance to exit; every level has exactly one solution. 500 levels plus Endless, Relax and Daily modes. Finish the line and watch the little train roll out.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers of LIGHT IT provide the following disclosure regarding the use of AI tools in the creation of this game. All AI-assisted content is pre-generated; the game does not generate any AI content live during gameplay.

Music: The in-game music was produced using Suno, an AI music-generation tool.

Art: Some visual assets were created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools.

Code: AI assistants were used to help brainstorm implementation ideas and to assist with debugging.

All AI-assisted content and code was reviewed, tested, and refined by the developer before being included in the final game.
